soulUrge:1: Soul Urge 1 in money — Your heart craves financial autonomy: your own business, full control, not dependent on anyone. Working under command is heavy for you.
soulUrge:2: Soul Urge 2 in money — Your heart wants financial security built with someone — partner, co-founder, team. Money alone feels hollow.
soulUrge:3: Soul Urge 3 in money — Your heart wants money that flows through self-expression — work, creativity, performance. Work that silences your voice withers you.
soulUrge:4: Soul Urge 4 in money — Your heart wants solid security: clear savings, clear structure, no surprises. Risky investments cost you sleep.
soulUrge:5: Soul Urge 5 in money — Your heart wants money that buys freedom, not money that ties you down. A fixed paycheck with office hours slowly kills you — you need variety.
soulUrge:6: Soul Urge 6 in money — Your heart wants money to care for the people you love — family, home, those who depend on you. Money just for yourself feels selfish.
soulUrge:7: Soul Urge 7 in money — Your heart wants money mainly to free up time to think, research, explore. Hustle culture doesn't resonate.
soulUrge:8: Soul Urge 8 in money — Your heart most clearly craves power and material achievement. Money is your main measure of feeling your life is valid.
soulUrge:9: Soul Urge 9 in money — Your heart wants money in service of something bigger — social cause, art, extended family. Pure self-money feels empty.
soulUrge:11: Soul Urge 11 in money (master) — Your heart craves money from a spiritual calling or inspiration that moves people. A 9-to-5 often feels disconnected.
soulUrge:22: Soul Urge 22 in money (master) — Your heart craves manifesting a big vision with tangible footprint: business, institution, infrastructure. Money is a tool, not a target.
soulUrge:33: Soul Urge 33 in money (master) — Your heart craves money that heals — for people, communities, the sick. Your career often has a service dimension.
expression:1: Expression 1 in money — Your gift is starting from zero: founding businesses, going solo, pioneering. Working as an employee often frustrates.
expression:2: Expression 2 in money — Your gift is teamwork, mediation, work that needs detail-sensitivity. Number-two often suits you better than top spot.
expression:3: Expression 3 in money — Your gift is communication, content, marketing, entertainment. Your income often flows through words, creation, or performance.
expression:4: Expression 4 in money — Your gift is systems, procedures, and consistent execution. Most stable income comes from work that rewards precision and persistence.
expression:5: Expression 5 in money — Your gift is sales, marketing, or work that needs fast adaptation and lots of human contact. Fixed cubicle pay caps you.
expression:6: Expression 6 in money — Your gift is work that cares: health, teaching, hospitality, interior design. Income comes through helping others live better.
expression:7: Expression 7 in money — Your gift is research, analysis, science, or deep specialization. Shallow work bores you; depth = money for you.
expression:8: Expression 8 in money — Your gift is business, finance, executive leadership. This is your most natural area — wealth-building flows when leaned into.
expression:9: Expression 9 in money — Your gift is work that serves many: arts, advocacy, social causes, mass education. Money flows when you serve.
expression:11: Expression 11 in money (master) — Your gift is inspiring through work: writing, teaching, speaking. Income via influence.
expression:22: Expression 22 in money (master) — Your gift is turning big ideas into reality. You can build scalable businesses or institutions.
expression:33: Expression 33 in money (master) — Your gift is work that heals and teaches with love. Income comes through being present and lifting people.
personality:1: Personality 1 in money — Your work impression: leader, decisive, confident. Bosses tag you for promotion; juniors sometimes find you intimidating.
personality:2: Personality 2 in money — Your work impression: calm teammate, easy to collaborate with, attuned to dynamics. Trust-builder vibe.
personality:3: Personality 3 in money — Your work impression: creative, expressive, positive energy. Vital on teams that need morale, sometimes seen as not serious in pure execution roles.
personality:4: Personality 4 in money — Your work impression: reliable, organized, no-nonsense. Clicks with formal bosses; can feel stiff in chaotic startup teams.
personality:5: Personality 5 in money — Your work impression: dynamic, idea-rich, adaptable. Suits sales, client-facing, and agile roles.
personality:6: Personality 6 in money — Your work impression: nurturing of the team, the one people vent to, attuned to people. A natural manager; often carries the team's burden alone.
personality:7: Personality 7 in money — Your work impression: smart, deep, prefers solo work. Specialist fits better than meeting-heavy social roles.
personality:8: Personality 8 in money — Your work impression: professional, classy, ambitious. Upmarket clients and senior roles tend to be drawn to this vibe.
personality:9: Personality 9 in money — Your work impression: empathic, broad, in service. Suits public-facing or many-people roles.
personality:11: Personality 11 in money (master) — Your work impression: an aura, intuitive, like you see what others haven't yet. Suits visioning roles.
personality:22: Personality 22 in money (master) — Your work impression: solid, capable, someone who can handle large projects. Investor & partner magnet.
personality:33: Personality 33 in money (master) — Your work impression: full of care and wisdom. Suits mentoring, healing, or community-building.
lifePath:1: Life Path 1 in money — Your career mission: be a pioneer in your chosen field. Build something from zero — a business, a brand, a new lane.
lifePath:2: Life Path 2 in money — Your career mission: be the strong number-two or partner who moves the team from behind. Your power is through collaboration, not solo.
lifePath:3: Life Path 3 in money — Your career mission: make a living through self-expression — words, art, performance, ideas. Conventional careers often choke you.
lifePath:4: Life Path 4 in money — Your career mission: build a lasting foundation — business, system, infrastructure. Results come through persistence, not shortcuts.
lifePath:5: Life Path 5 in money — Your career mission: a life that changes, travels, and meets many people. Static careers make you run.
lifePath:6: Life Path 6 in money — Your career mission: a profession that cares for others — health, education, services, or family business. Money flows when you become someone people lean on.
lifePath:7: Life Path 7 in money — Your career mission: deep work — research, analysis, science, or spiritual. Shallow work drains you.
lifePath:8: Life Path 8 in money — Your career mission: learn to manage power and material resources with integrity. Significant wealth-building is your lane.
lifePath:9: Life Path 9 in money — Your career mission: serve something larger than yourself — movements, art, community. Money purely for yourself often doesn't arrive.
lifePath:11: Life Path 11 in money (master) — Your career mission: inspire through influence — speaking, writing, teaching. Your life work often involves a platform.
lifePath:22: Life Path 22 in money (master) — Your career mission: manifest a big, durable vision. Business, movement, or institution.
lifePath:33: Life Path 33 in money (master) — Your career mission: teach and heal with love. A career with a deep service dimension.
personalYear:1: Personal Year 1 in money — A financial fresh-start year. Perfect for starting a business, switching careers, or opening a new lane.
personalYear:2: Personal Year 2 in money — A year of financial collaboration. Partnerships, joint ventures, team work outperform solo moves.
personalYear:3: Personal Year 3 in money — A creative year. Business from creation or ideas can shine; spending also leaks easily — budget carefully.
personalYear:4: Personal Year 4 in money — A year of hard foundation work. Results may not yet show, but what you stake now is the capital for later.
personalYear:5: Personal Year 5 in money — A year of financial change. Job change, location change, or business model shift. High volatility — keep a buffer.
personalYear:6: Personal Year 6 in money — A year of investment in family or home responsibility. Lots of care-spending — alongside it, income from helping others also flows.
personalYear:7: Personal Year 7 in money — A career introspection year. Right for upskilling, study, or long sabbaticals. Aggressive push doesn't run well this year.
personalYear:8: Personal Year 8 in money — A financial harvest year. Career and wealth-building most fertile — investors, big deals, promotions often arrive.
personalYear:9: Personal Year 9 in money — A closing year. Projects, partnerships, or old careers wrap up. Settle accounts so you're ready for next year's fresh start.
personalYear:11: Personal Year 11 in money (master) — A visionary opening year. Right for launching moving ideas, public speaking, or building influence.
personalYear:22: Personal Year 22 in money (master) — A year for manifesting a big project. Launching a business, buying a large asset, building infrastructure.
personalYear:33: Personal Year 33 in money (master) — A career-as-service year. Income flows from work that heals and lifts.
bridge:0: Bridge 0 in money — Your career mission (Life Path) and natural talents (Expression) are identical. You're born carrying skills that directly match what you're here to do. Execution is easy, occasionally boring because there's not much stretch.
bridge:1: Bridge 1 in money — Your natural gifts almost match your career mission. You start running with minimal tuning.
bridge:2: Bridge 2 in money — Small gap between innate skills and what the mission demands. Mostly aligned; occasionally you learn an adjacent skill.
bridge:3: Bridge 3 in money — A rhythm difference between your natural talent and what the mission asks. E.g., talent in creativity, mission demands structure — balances if acknowledged.
bridge:4: Bridge 4 in money — Moderate gap. Consistent work is needed to build skills you weren't born with. Results layer, not instant.
bridge:5: Bridge 5 in money — Real tug between gift and mission. Sometimes feels like living two parallel careers — the key is giving both room.
bridge:6: Bridge 6 in money — Big gap between skill and mission. Integration needs conscious work, but once merged you can do work whose combination is rare.
bridge:7: Bridge 7 in money — Big distance with a contemplation-vs-execution or spiritual-vs-material theme. Your career often holds two worlds in tension.
bridge:8: Bridge 8 in money — The widest gap between natural gift and career mission. Deepest growth lives here — you're pushed to develop skills you weren't born with, and the result is you become rare in your field.
